verdicts.reason: A is just the portrait original shrunk into a thin strip in the middle of the leaderboard. Everything else is dead white space, and 'Your personal' and MUSINA.FR are too small to read, so it fails fit-to-format entirely. B at least spreads out horizontally and the FITNESS TRAINER headline is readable, but it is broken: the photo is a tiny cropped thumbnail, the purple blocks and yellow bars float with no relation to each other, the headline spills off its narrow purple panel, 'Your personal' and the MUSINA.FR brand URL are gone, and there are large empty white gaps between the fragments.
